entries.title: Holy Eucharist Service
entries.text: All are welcome to our Holy Eucharist service today, Fri, Nov 20, 3:15pm, St. Alban’s Chapel. Join us to pause, pray, and share in the Holy Sacrament of bread and wine; grape juice is available for those under 21. Please come as you can to begin the weekend.

MUSICAL THEATRE CLASSES IN CONCERT at Mamiya Theatre this weekend! Join us on tonight, Fri and/or tomorrow, Sat night, 7pm, Mamiya Theatre on the St. Louis Campus for an evening of Musical Theatre! Musical Theatre 3, our top level class takes the stage on Friday, and on Saturday at 7pm Musical Theatre levels 1 and 2 will share a different program! NO TICKETS needed! This event is free and open to the public. Doors open for seating at 6:30pm both days. Come enjoy songs from Beauty and the Beast, A Chorus Line, Wicked, Rent, and more!
VIRTUAL POP-UP! Get your Young Entrepreneurs Club Virtual Pop-up pre-orders in before it's too late! Pickup will be Monday, November 30.

entries.text: Play this short video (1:55) for a snapshot of the work of IHS - the Institute for Human Services - and Aloha Harvest. See what kinds of foods are most needed in the food drive next week!

entries.title: A Chance to Address Period Poverty
entries.text: According to the National Institutes of Health, 30% of women struggle to afford period products, and 1 in 2 of them face associated psychological challenges. Let’s do our part to support all menstruators in accessing the resources they need. The Period Warriors are collecting period products and clean, like-new towels for our friends at IHS. Every item you share can make a difference. Please bring your donations to the Upper School Auto Line during the Thanksgiving Food Drive on Tuesday & Wednesday! OneTeam.PERIOD.

entries.title: 3 More Days to Write Happy Notes for the Foodbank
entries.text: Reminder to visit the letter-writing tables at the back of the chapel! You will be supporting keiki who receive food to take home to their families through the Foodbank’s School Pantry program.

entries.title: NAMI Club Event
entries.text: Take a breather and join NAMI on 11/25, Wednesday, during lunch/meeting period in Arillaga Takaki Terrace Floor Commons for a relaxing afternoon of cookie decorating! We’re featuring the viral TikTok dot cookie trend alongside a variety of other classic sugar cookie flavors and frostings. Bring a friend and unwind with us! KāKOʻO ALOHA: Interested in service hours? Help assemble holiday cards for Kāhala Nui nursing residents on Mon, Nov 23, during lunch. There will be free food and non-club members are welcome to sign up, so please bring your friends! Sign up link: https://forms.gle/fNsRXVGzBSTX8vyG8
